Elev8 broker’s Charity October: seeing new opportunities together

  • By PressRelease
  • October 5, 2026
  • Share
Preferred source

0:00 / 1:50
Instaread

This October, the global broker Elev8 is running Charity October, a social initiative that supports underprivileged schoolchildren in Bangladesh.

Throughout the month, for every lot traded by Charity October participants, the broker will donate to an educational charity project to support underprivileged young students.

The initiative is built around a simple idea: as you start seeing new opportunities for yourself, you can help others along the way.

Participation is free, and no donation is required. The participants’ contribution will be calculated based on eligible lots traded in October.

For this project, Elev8 has partnered with JAAGO Foundation, a non-profit supporting underprivileged children and communities in Bangladesh. The project aims to open up more opportunities for young students so they can make better progress towards their dream careers.

Together with JAAGO Foundation, Elev8 aims to provide:

  • essential school supplies for 5,000 students
  • digital classroom equipment for at least 800 students over the next five years.

The campaign brings young and talented students closer to the tools and resources they need to achieve their dreams.

More information about Charity October and its progress is available on the project landing page.

Elev8 is a licensed global broker serving 18+ million traders in 100+ countries. It offers market access through 3 platforms: Elev8Trader, MetaTrader 4, and MetaTrader 5. Operating under licences from Mauritius and Seychelles, Elev8 provides traders with the tools to help spot and capture more market opportunities. The broker received the ‘Best Trading Experience Broker 2026’ and the ‘Best Trading Platform Provider 2026’ awards from FxDailyInfo.
